_comment: Contract fixture. Every entry is a value recovered from the source PDFs.
Duplicating the values here is deliberate: it is what turns the check from
a tautology into a real gate. Deriving the probe from theme.css alone means
a renamed or mistyped token still produces its (wrong) utility and passes.
Changing a value in theme.css must also change it here, which forces the
edit to be intentional. If the designer revises the PDF, update both.
Only measured and derived values are pinned. INFERRED values are free to
change without touching this file, because they are our decisions, not the
designer's, and OPEN-QUESTIONS.md tracks them instead.
